sources.entry: Open Source POS - Open Source Point of Sale is a web based point of sale system. MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Open Source Point of Sale is a web-based point of sale system written in PHP on MySQL or MariaDB, covering sales, inventory, invoicing and reporting.
summary.what_it_does: The application provides a browser-based sale register with transaction logging, stock management for items and kits with extensible attributes, and VAT/GST/customer/multi-tier taxation. It supports quotations and invoices, expense logging, a cash-up function, and printing or emailing of receipts, invoices and quotations. It also includes barcode generation and printing, a customer and supplier database, multiuser accounts with permission control, and reporting on sales, orders, expenses and inventory. Extras listed include receivings, gift cards, rewards, restaurant tables, SMS messaging, multilanguage support, Bootswatch UI themes, MailChimp integration, optional Google reCAPTCHA on login, and GDPR-ready features.
use_cases: run a retail point of sale in the browser
track stock and inventory for a shop
log expenses and do daily cash-up
manage customers, suppliers and gift cards
how_to_run: Read INSTALL.md for supported installation methods (the README says only those described there are supported)
Use BUILD.md to build from source
Use UPGRADE.md when upgrading an existing installation
Try the live demo with username admin and password pointofsale
Download the latest release zip from GitHub releases instead of cloning if you see 'system folder missing'
notable: Version 3.4 is a full rewrite on CodeIgniter 4
Live demo reinitializes automatically from master
Supports multi-tier taxation including VAT and GST
License requires the footer copyright signature to remain visible and unmodified
caveats: Only installation methods documented in INSTALL.md are supported
License adds conditions: footer notice must stay visible and unmodified, and license files must not be removed
